# Block 4 Inferential Statistical Report: Bucket 2 -> Bucket 3 (Option 1 Nested Architecture)

> **Complete 109-Table Unmerged Nested Specification (plus 18 Summary Stack Tables):**
> - **Part 1: PROBE OFF Baseline ($N = 300$ across 30 runs):** Tables 1.1 to 1.36 (Labelled, Mislabelled, Unlabelled x Model POV & Seat POV x Step 6->10, Step 9->10, Step 6->11, Step 9->11, Step 6->12, Step 9->12) + Probe OFF Summary Stack.
> - **Part 2: PROBE ON Intervention ($N = 300$ across 30 runs):** Tables 2.1 to 2.36 (Labelled, Mislabelled, Unlabelled x Model POV & Seat POV x Step 6->10, Step 9->10, Step 6->11, Step 9->11, Step 6->12, Step 9->12) + Probe ON Summary Stack.
> - **Part 3: COMBINED Both Averaged ($N = 600$ across 60 runs):** Tables 3.1 to 3.36 + Triple-Average Summary Stack (Probe OFF Average, Probe ON Average, Meta Grand Average).
> - **Part 4: Upstream Step Competition & Influence Ranking (Step 6 vs. Step 9 -> Steps 10, 11, 12):** Table 4.1.
>
> **Cell Format & Statistical Protocol:**
> - Every cell reports `[Exhibited Behavior % vs. Did Not Exhibit % (p-value)]`.
> - Every outcome column has its own dedicated two-tailed Fisher's exact test p-value.
> - Upstream steps (Step 6 Collective Action Vote and Step 9 Governance Policy) and downstream steps (Steps 10, 11, 12) are strictly separated into distinct tables.
